_about: Sumber kebenaran rujukan CASS-NV (CorVa Space). Setiap aturan di corva/labels.py (EVIDENCE) menunjuk kunci di sini; tests/test_corva_evidence.py memeriksa keterlacakannya. doi_verified=false atau authors_complete=false berarti harus dicek ke naskah asli sebelum dikutip. read = bagian yang sudah dibaca (abstract/full text).

barry2007.title: EEG differences between eyes-closed and eyes-open resting conditions
barry2007.finding: Alfa rata-rata berkorelasi negatif dengan konduktansi kulit dan turun saat mata dibuka; alfa layak sebagai ukuran arousal istirahat.

berntson1991.title: Autonomic determinism: the modes of autonomic control, the doctrine of autonomic space, and the laws of autonomic constraint
berntson1991.finding: Mode kendali otonom tidak berada pada satu kontinum simpatis-parasimpatis, tetapi di ruang dua dimensi (autonomic space).

bird2018.title: A study on mental state classification using EEG-based brain-machine interface
bird2018.journal: IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Systems (IS)
bird2018.finding: Muse 4 kanal diklasifikasikan menjadi relaxed/neutral/concentrating (n = 5); preseden label kualitatif dari Muse.

borghini2014.title: Measuring neurophysiological signals in aircraft pilots and car drivers for the assessment of mental workload, fatigue and drowsiness
borghini2014.finding: Beban kerja tinggi: theta naik, alfa turun. Peralihan ke kelelahan: theta, delta, dan alfa naik.

candiarivera2022.title: Cardiac sympathetic-vagal activity initiates a functional brain-body response to emotional arousal
candiarivera2022.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
candiarivera2022.finding: Interaksi otak-jantung dua arah; aktivitas simpatis-vagal jantung memodulasi respons otak terhadap arousal.

cannard2021.title: Validating the wearable MUSE headset for EEG spectral analysis and Frontal Alpha Asymmetry
cannard2021.journal: IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics and Biomedicine (BIBM)
cannard2021.finding: Muse menangkap spektrum daya, frekuensi alfa individual, dan asimetri alfa frontal sebanding dengan BioSemi 64 kanal.

crabbe2004.title: Brain electrocortical activity during and after exercise: a quantitative synthesis
crabbe2004.finding: Saat dan sesudah latihan daya absolut alfa naik, tetapi delta, theta, dan beta juga naik; tidak khas alfa.

ehrhardt2022.title: Separating EEG correlates of stress: cognitive effort, time pressure, and social-evaluative threat
ehrhardt2022.finding: Saat PASAT dibanding istirahat, alfa frontal turun dan beta naik; daya EEG frontal membedakan stres dari istirahat, tetapi tidak membedakan derajat stres (n = 38).

esco2014.title: Ultra-short-term heart rate variability indexes at rest and post-exercise in athletes: evaluating the agreement with accepted recommendations
esco2014.journal: Journal of Sports Science and Medicine
esco2014.finding: lnRMSSD 60 s sesuai dengan rekaman 5 menit pada atlet, saat istirahat dan pascalatihan.

griadhi2026.title: Muse 2 versus Polar H10 validation study (B1)
griadhi2026.finding: Denyut Muse 2 sesuai dengan Polar H10, tetapi RMSSD ultra-singkat (60 s) dari PPG dahi ditaksir berlebih.

klimesch1999.title: EEG alpha and theta oscillations reflect cognitive and memory performance: a review and analysis
klimesch1999.finding: Theta terkait penyandian informasi baru; alfa atas terkait pencarian memori; pita alfa sebaiknya individual.

krigolson2017.title: Choosing MUSE: validation of a low-cost, portable EEG system for ERP research
krigolson2017.finding: Muse (TP9, AF7, AF8, TP10) menangkap N200, P300, dan reward positivity pada 60 peserta.

kubota2001.title: Frontal midline theta rhythm is correlated with cardiac autonomic activities during the performance of an attention demanding meditation procedure
kubota2001.finding: Saat theta frontal-midline muncul pada meditasi atentif, indeks vagal dan simpatis berubah; korteks frontal medial terkait fungsi otonom jantung.

laborde2017.title: Heart rate variability and cardiac vagal tone in psychophysiological research: recommendations for experiment planning, data analysis, and data reporting
laborde2017.finding: RMSSD dianjurkan untuk rekaman pendek; LF/HF tidak dianjurkan sebagai keseimbangan simpatovagal; PPG bukan pengganti EKG saat bergerak.

laborde2018.title: Vagal Tank Theory: the three Rs of cardiac vagal control functioning - resting, reactivity, and recovery
laborde2018.finding: Kendali vagal dinilai pada tiga tingkat: istirahat, reaktivitas, pemulihan.

munoz2015.title: Validity of (ultra-)short recordings for heart rate variability measurements
munoz2015.finding: RMSSD 10 s r = 0,85-0,86 terhadap 4-5 menit; tiga potongan 10 s r = 0,94; 120 s hampir sempurna (n = 3.387).

plews2012.title: Heart rate variability in elite triathletes, is variation in variability the key to effective training? A case comparison
plews2012.finding: Rata-rata 7 hari lnRMSSD menurun pada atlet yang mengalami non-functional overreaching.

pope1995.title: Biocybernetic system evaluates indices of operator engagement in automated task
pope1995.finding: Di antara indeks yang diuji, beta/(alpha + theta) paling baik mencerminkan keterlibatan tugas.

russell1980.title: A circumplex model of affect
russell1980.journal: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
russell1980.finding: Keadaan afektif dipetakan pada dua dimensi (valensi, arousal) dengan penamaan kualitatif per wilayah.

shaffer2017.title: An overview of heart rate variability metrics and norms
shaffer2017.finding: Norma HRV bergantung pada panjang rekaman, usia, dan jenis kelamin; norma 24 jam, jangka pendek, dan ultra-pendek tidak bisa dipertukarkan.

stanley2013.title: Cardiac parasympathetic reactivation following exercise: implications for training prescription
stanley2013.finding: Reaktivasi parasimpatis pascalatihan; pemulihan otonom penuh hingga 24 jam (intensitas rendah), 24-48 jam (ambang), dan >= 48 jam (intensitas tinggi).

thayer2000.title: A model of neurovisceral integration in emotion regulation and dysregulation
thayer2000.finding: Model integrasi neuroviseral: sistem otonom, atensi, dan afek dalam satu jaringan; kegagalan inhibisi memunculkan aktivasi simpatis relatif.

thayer2009.title: Heart rate variability, prefrontal neural function, and cognitive performance: the neurovisceral integration perspective on self-regulation, adaptation, and health
thayer2009.finding: HRV berkaitan dengan fungsi prefrontal dan kinerja eksekutif; mengubah HRV istirahat mengubah kinerja eksekutif.
